via.name: Little Wanganui River swing bridge
via.quote: drops steeply to the Little Wanganui River

evidence: The route is described here from east to west.
Cross the ford and continue 7 km up the valley to Prices clearing, where there is an information kiosk and intentions book. The track starts 1 km further on at the Rolling River car park.
It is a further 4 km to the end of the route at the Wangapeka Road car park.

ways.label: Biggs Tops/Trevor Carter Hut alternative between Wangapeka Saddle and Taipo footbridge
evidence: At Wangapeka Saddle a route leads over Biggs Tops and heads steeply down to Trevor Carter Hut.

From here there are three ways to get back on the main route: Lost Valley Track to Helicopter Flat Hut; Saxon Falls Track, rejoining near Tabernacle lookout; or across the Karamea and along its true left bank to Taipo footbridge.

doubts: The page describes the route east to west; direction is not recorded because the walk is one way, not a loop. W2 is the page's Biggs Tops/Trevor Carter Hut alternative section between Wangapeka Saddle and Taipo footbridge (with its own heading and time), not a whole end-to-end way; from Trevor Carter Hut it offers three ways back to the main route and I used its last-named end (Taipo footbridge), which has no entry. Tabernacle lookout, Taipo footbridge and Gilmor Clearing have no entries. Belltown Manunui Hut is set back 60 m from the main track and Stag Flat Bivvy is adjacent to the route; both counted as on the way. Cecil Kings Hut is 5 min further up the main track from Kings Creek Hut.
